name: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics
description: Access your Adobe Customer Journey Analytics data directly in Claude. Query metrics, dimensions, and segments programmatically to integrate cross-channel journey data from Adobe Customer Journey Analytics into your AI agents, workflows, and applications — and build analysis pipelines that match your own methodology. Pull metric data, create and manage segments and calculated metrics, and get instant answers directly in the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adobe Customer Journey Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adobe Customer Journey Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cja-mcp.adobe.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adobe Customer Journey Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics lists 26 MCP tools, including describe_Cja, describe_Dimension, describe_Metric, describe_Project, describe_Audience, describe_Segment, describe_Calculated_Metric, find_DataViews, find_Dimensions, find_Metrics, find_Segments, and find_CalculatedMetrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adobe Customer Journey Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adobe Customer Journey Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Adobe Customer Journey Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Adobe Customer Journey Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics is developed by Adobe. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
